mostWorthwhile.text: Building the coarse pebble shore was most worthwhile: abrasion rounded the stones, then sorting explained why heavier material remained at the headland.

leastWorthwhile.text: Creating waves breaking on the headland felt like a predictable intermediate step before the rock actually broke loose.

surprise.text: The beach being a moving store of sediment, rather than a permanent pile, changed how I thought about the finished shore.

arbitrary.text: The distinction between applying breaking waves and wind-driven waves to the angular stones was not immediately clear, although their results served different shore-building routes.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter: the contrasting shore processes made a familiar landscape more understandable, despite several predictable intermediate actions.
